content.text: Intent
A minimal register of people: each person carries a name and an age. Any signed-in user can browse, create, edit and delete people through the entity's standard screens.
Scope
IN: a Person entity with two fields (name, age) and its standard entity screens.
OUT: relationships to other entities, addresses, contact details, identity documents, any lifecycle or workflow.
Scenarios
None — plain create/edit/browse/delete, no ordered journey beyond the bean's standard screens.
Requirements
None — every rule is carried by the bean table.
Data model
bean: Person
User interface
The Person search screen and edit form.
Dependencies
None — new entity, no existing entity or spec is reused.
Constraints
Considered, none apply beyond the platform's own rules: authorization, performance, volume, availability, audit, privacy, locale, cost.
Acceptance criteria
None — the platform's generated tests cover the table rules (name required; age required, 0–150).
Migration & compatibility
None — new entity, nothing to migrate.
Artifacts
A Person entity with a people search screen and edit form.
Derived from the Data model
Implied by the bean blocks in the Data model and regenerated by the platform - do not edit this block; author above it what the catalog cannot derive.

Person - persistence.entity (persistence): The entity class with its builder, its descriptor + jsontype entry, its migration and table, and its tests; the descriptor is authored at spec time as the bean's entry in the spec's entity_descriptors.json.
Person - observer.sheet (observer): The observer sheet: the entity's only remote surface, reads and writes.

Person - ui.defaultForm (ui): The default form of one row, rendered wherever the row is viewed or edited: its layout JS, authored at spec time as the spec folder's ui/{qualified-descriptor-name}.js and shipped beside the entity class.
Person.age - validation.rule (persistence): min(0) - enforced on save and covered by a generated test
Person.age - validation.rule (persistence): max(150) - enforced on save and covered by a generated test
